name: Colossal Step
description: Make a great stair of qi ahead of the foot and take one vast stride across it.

name: Colossal Guard
description: Make a colossal shield of qi before the body that takes the weight of a heavy blow.

name: Colossal Bind
description: Make massive bands of made stone about a foe's limbs and set them hard.

name: Colossal Mend
description: Make a great deal of new flesh at once and close deep wounds on an ally.

name: Colossal Lance
description: Make a lance as long as a tower and drive it through everything in its line.

name: Colossal Aegis
description: Make a vast bastion of made stone about the user and allies that heavy blows cannot breach.

name: Colossal Chain
description: Make a chain of three great forms in quick order each striking where the last left off.

name: Colossal Renewal
description: Make breath and a beating heart for an ally who has just fallen and pull them back from the edge.

name: Colossal Hammer
description: Make a hammer the size of a hill and bring it down on a single foe.

name: Colossal Surge
description: Make a surge of new matter that sweeps the field and heaps itself over the foes.

name: Colossal Pillar
description: Make a pillar of made stone that drives down on a foe and holds them pinned beneath it.

name: Worldwright Hand
description: Make a great hand of qi above the field whose size and weight follow the reserve poured into it.

name: Calamity Genesis
description: Raise a mountain of made stone over the field so all beneath it is crushed up to the ceiling of a Core-tier master.

name: Absolute Step
description: Make a road of divine matter ahead of the foot and cross it in one stride.

name: Absolute Guard
description: Make a guard of divine matter before the body that holds against the heaviest blow.

name: Absolute Bind
description: Make bonds of divine matter that close on a foe's limbs and cannot be forced.

name: Absolute Mend
description: Make whole flesh from divine energy over an ally's gravest wounds.

name: Absolute Lance
description: Make a lance of divine matter and drive it through ranks of foes and the ground behind them.

name: Absolute Aegis
description: Make a bastion of divine matter that turns aside blows of great weight.

name: Absolute Chain
description: Make three forms of divine matter in order each fastened to the one before.

name: Absolute Renewal
description: Make breath and pulse for an ally whose life has just ended and call them back within moments.

name: Absolute Hammer
description: Make a hammer of divine matter and bring it down on one foe with a mountain's weight.

name: Absolute Surge
description: Make a surge of divine matter that rolls over the field and buries all in its path.

name: Absolute Pillar
description: Make a pillar of divine matter and drive it down so the foe is pinned beneath its foot.

name: Absolute Hand
description: Make a vast hand of divine matter over the field whose reach and weight follow the reserve poured into it.

name: Final Making
description: Raise a land of divine matter over a whole region and crush all beneath it up to the ceiling of a divine master.

name: Endless Making
description: Keep raising divine matter over a battlefield until the foes are buried to the ceiling of a divine master.
